title: Diff Explorer + Triage Orchestrator for Benchmark Anomalies
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: We ingest continuous benchmark runs (tokens/sec, p95 latency, success rate) from staged and canary fleets. Engineers need a fast way to 1) compare two or more runs, 2) see where regressions are concentrated (model, sequence length, batch size), and 3) run an automated isolation workflow that spins up an isolation harness and records deterministic microbenchmarks. Goal: ship a Diff Explorer UI component + backend comparison API + triage orchestrator playbook that ties benchmark storage to triage automation and creates actionable incident tickets when regressions are detected.
acceptance_criteria: Comparison API: given two run IDs, return per-metric diffs (tokens/sec, p95, p99, error-rate) broken down by dimension tags within 300ms for typical payload sizes
UI: Diff Explorer shows a summary delta, a sortable table of top-10 offending dimensions, tokens/sec time-series sparkline, and a p95 heatmap with hoverable sample traces
Triage Orchestrator: a configurable workflow that can kick off replays (synthetic isolation) and attach results & recommended rollbacks to a generated ticket
Storage: schema supports labeled dimension keys, run fingerprint, and stable aggregation windows; 12 months of compressed storage available via warehouse export
Alerts: integration with regression detector must produce proof artifacts (side-by-side traces + isolation run result) before auto-assigning high-priority tickets
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (API + storage): extend benchmark-result-store schema to include run_fingerprint, dimension_tags, and sample_trace pointers; add compare endpoint that computes delta and significance using rolling-baseline stats
Phase 2 (UI): surface Diff Explorer in Console under Benchmarks -> Compare. Implement top-n offending-dimensions table and heatmap tile using existing chart components
Phase 3 (Orchestrator): build triage workflow that can (a) enqueue isolation runs, (b) attach artifacts, (c) create Linear ticket draft and optionally auto-assign based on confidence thresholds
Phase 4 (E2E & hardening): load-test compare API at concurrent 100 requests, add regression-simulated datasets, and run incident drills with SRE team
data_model_notes: Storage schema (flat): run_id, run_fingerprint, timestamp, model_variant, sequence_length_bin, batch_size, tokens_sec_agg, p95_ms, p99_ms, error_rate, sample_trace_id, environment_tags (comma-separated). We will store denormalized rows for fast group-by and export nightly aggregates to the warehouse. Compression: delta-encoded time series and snappy for traces.
triage_playbook: Step 1: On alert, open Diff Explorer and confirm metric delta > configured threshold and anomaly score > 0.8
Step 2: Use top-dimensions table to identify likely contributors (model_variant, seq_len_bin)
Step 3: Click 'Run Isolation' to spin up synthetic harness against canary pool; wait for isolation run and attach artifacts
Step 4: If isolation reproduces regression, mark ticket P0, attach traces, recommend rollback or hotfix; if not, mark as flaky and schedule expanded test
Step 5: Add retrospective notes and link to incident dashboard
